# RealSense C# bindings

Unmodified C# wrapper sources from RealSense librealsense v2.59.1,
commit `625279aa1fe903528a818f48746ee47c1b5fefd3`:
https://github.com/realsenseai/librealsense/tree/v2.59.1/wrappers/csharp/Intel.RealSense

Built for .NET 9 by `managed/Piper.RealSense/Piper.RealSense.csproj`.
The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included in this directory. The matching
Windows native library is extracted from the hash-verified official SDK by
`tools/Prepare-CameraRuntime.ps1`; the SDK installer is never run.
